mechanism: Isoniazid may inhibit hepatic metabolism of cefuroxime and both agents can cause hepatotoxicity with potential additive risk; cephalosporins may rarely affect isoniazid levels through altered renal clearance.
action: Monitor hepatic function tests (ALT, AST, bilirubin) at baseline and periodically during concurrent use; counsel patients on signs of hepatotoxicity; consider dosage adjustment if hepatic impairment develops.
